title: A stack checking brackets, then a queue

frames.note: Check the brackets of "a[b(c)d]e" with a stack
'a' is not a bracket: skip it
'[' opens: push it
'b' is not a bracket: skip it
'(' opens: push it
'c' is not a bracket: skip it
')' closes: pop '(', which matches
Stack after the pop
'd' is not a bracket: skip it
']' closes: pop '[', which matches
The stack is empty again
'e' is not a bracket: skip it
End of text and the stack is empty: balanced
Now a queue: values join at the back and leave from the front
enqueue 1 at the back
enqueue 2 at the back
enqueue 3 at the back
enqueue 4 at the back
dequeue 1 from the front: first in, first out
dequeue 2 from the front: first in, first out
Two left, in the order they arrived
